learner_operation: Inspect the given equation and each option; identify an algebraically equivalent equation with unit derivative coefficient, all y terms on the left, and y-independent right side. Standard-form recognition alone is insufficient when several options share that form.

shortcut_probes.cue: Repeated literal left and right sides of answer equations
shortcut_probes.strategy: Split each option at =; score count(left)+count(right); select the unique maximum; abstain on ties. Never inspect prompt or parse coefficients.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 5/5 versus uniform guessing 1/5. A perfect conditional predictor of the key is unrelated to algebraic equivalence or standard form.

Shortcut remains perfect in five affected template subgroups (36/36 delivered, 56/56 raw observations), and succeeds 4/5 runner records.
